summary: Fathom Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive Merger Agreement with Bed Bath Beyond Inc. (Parent) and its merger sub. Under the terms, each share of Fathom common stock will be converted into 0.2236 shares of Parent stock, plus cash for fractional shares, subject to an Equity Value Shortfall adjustment. The merger is structured as a reverse triangular merger with Fathom surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary. No appraisal rights are available under North Carolina law. Outstanding options will be canceled for no consideration; restricted stock and RSUs (except non-employee director RSUs) will be assumed by Parent. The board recommended the deal; no advisor named. Watch for shareholder vote, regulatory clearance, and the equity value adjustment mechanism.
